claims.text: The resort is set in the Umbrian countryside near Perugia.

findings.quote: Nestled in the verdant Umbrian countryside near Perugia, Italy

claims.text: The resort was restored by the Spagnulo & Partners architectural studio, integrating local craftsmanship and Renaissance art elements.

findings.quote: owing to its meticulous restoration by the Spagnulo & Partners Architectural Studio. This restoration has successfully integrated local craftsmanship and Renaissance art elements

claims.text: Room types include the Rossi Scotti Apartments, the Conti Suite and the Conte Suite.

findings.quote: Each room, including the Rossi Scotti Apartments, Conti Suite, Conte Suite, and more

claims.text: Dining includes fine dining at Cedri Restaurant, casual meals at Osteria del Borgo and drinks at the Lounge Bar.

findings.quote: from the fine dining experience at Cedri Restaurant to casual meals at Osteria del Borgo, and a variety of drinks at the Lounge Bar

claims.text: Activities include outdoor cinema, picnics in the olive grove, cooking classes, wine tasting and truffle hunting.

findings.quote: outdoor cinema, romantic dinners, picnics in the olive grove, cooking classes, wine tasting, and truffle hunting

claims.text: The area around the resort has Etruscan remnants, medieval villages and hamlets.

findings.quote: Surrounded by Etruscan remnants, medieval villages, and charming hamlets

claims.text: A winding road leads up through an ilex forest to the estate buildings.

findings.quote: leads you up a winding road through a dark ilex forest to the sunny heights above, where a group of estate buildings

claims.text: Rooms all have roomy double-sink bathrooms.

findings.quote: a series of spacious rooms, all different, all with roomy double-sink bathrooms

claims.text: Perugia is less than half an hour away by car.

findings.quote: is less than half an hour away by car

claims.text: Pets are welcome, and five terrace suites are advised for dog owners.

findings.quote: Pets are welcome; dog owners are advised to book one of five terrace suites

claims.text: The Conte and Contessa piano nobile suites have original frescoed friezes and ornate heraldic fireplaces.

findings.quote: two “piano nobile” suites, Conte and Contessa, that are full of original detail from the era of the Rossi Scotti counts, such as frescoed friezes and ornate heraldic fireplaces

claims.text: Rooms feature period frescoes, coffered ceilings and views of the countryside or the resort's cloister.

findings.quote: Guests can expect period frescoes, coffered ceilings, and breathtaking views of the countryside or the resort's cloister

claims.text: The spa is in the villa's western wing and offers indoor and outdoor wellness experiences.

findings.quote: the luxurious spa in the villa's western wing provides both indoor and outdoor wellness experiences

claims.text: The resort has an outdoor infinity pool and forest walking trails.

findings.quote: the capacious outdoor infinity pool comes into its own, but the resort’s forest walking trails

findings.quote: its April to November seasonal opening
